title: Shopware LSP Administration Modules
description: The Administration modules of a plugin that Shopware LSP generates from its entities (src/Resources/shopware-lsp/admin-modules.yaml).

version.description: The version of the format. Version 1 always derives the same module from the same entity.

modules.description: The modules by their name: lower-case words joined by dashes, with a prefix (acme-review).

props.description: Attributes written onto the element as they are.

entity.description: The technical name of the entity the module manages. It must be defined by the plugin itself.

title.description: The name of the module per locale; derived from the entity name when absent.

description.description: The description of the module per locale.

icon.description: The icon of the module from the Meteor icon kit, such as regular-star.

color.description: The color of the module, such as #ff3d58.

labelField.description: The property that names a record: the link of the list and the title of the detail page.

locales.description: The locales snippet files are written for; en-GB and de-DE when absent.

navigation.description: The entry of the module in the main menu.

enable.description: false leaves the module out of the menu.

parent.description: The id of the menu entry the module is listed below; sw-extension when absent.

position.description: The place among the entries of the same parent.

acl.description: The roles of the module: viewer, editor, creator and deleter.

enable.description: false generates no roles and checks none.

parent.description: The group of the permission grid the roles are listed in.

managed.description: false hands the page over: it is written once more outside generated/ and never again.

auto.description: false shows the columns named here only; new fields of the entity no longer appear on their own.

limit.description: The number of records per page.

columns.description: The columns by the property of the entity they show.

sorting.description: The order of the list when it is opened.

field.description: The property the list is sorted by.

position.description: The place among the columns; derived columns are 10 apart.

label.description: The heading of the column per locale.

sortable.description: Whether the list can be sorted by the column.

inlineEdit.description: Whether the value can be edited in the list.

managed.description: false hands the page over: it is written once more outside generated/ and never again.

auto.description: false shows the fields named in a card only; new fields of the entity no longer appear on their own.

cards.description: The cards of the form by their name; derived fields go to the card general.

title.description: The title of the card per locale.

fields.description: The fields of the card by the property of the entity they edit.

enable.description: false removes the field from the form.

position.description: The place among the fields of the card; derived fields are 10 apart.

label.description: The label of the input per locale.

helpText.description: The help text of the input per locale.

placeholder.description: The placeholder of the input per locale.

required.description: Whether the input is marked as required; derived from the field when absent.

label.description: The text of the option per locale.

component.description: The input of the field, by its type; derived from the field when absent.

type.description: A text field of several lines.

numberType.description: Derived from the field when absent.

type.description: A switch for yes or no.
A picker for date and time.

options.description: The values to choose from; the choices of the field when absent.

type.description: A choice from the records of an entity.

entity.description: The entity to choose from; the target of the association when absent.

labelProperty.description: The property that names a record of the entity.

type.description: A component of the plugin: it gets the value, the label and the error of the field.

name.description: The name the component is registered with.
